Literal.Value:
'Recommended actions (from action codes)

• O-O1.1 — Operations Stabilisation
  Owner: maintenance_manager
  Trigger: ops.availability.pct < 85.0%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 3.0–8.0 pp
  Confidence: High
  · IDENTIFY top recurring downtime categories on this production line
  · PRIORITISE chronic failure modes for this line
  · EXECUTE corrective maintenance and standardisation on this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if downtime is dominated by recurring failure categories
  ⚠ Do not trigger if availability loss is driven by approved changeovers

• O-O1.2 — Performance Uplift
  Owner: production_manager
  Trigger: ops.performance.pct < 90.0%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 2.0–6.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify lines with sustained performance loss
  · Analyze micro-stops and speed losses
  · Implement line balance and standard work corrections
  ⚠ Trigger only if availability is stable (>= 90%)
  ⚠ Do not trigger if performance loss is driven by quality rework

• O-O1.3 — Quality & Yield Recovery
  Owner: quality_manager
  Trigger: ops.quality.pct < 96.0%
  Impact: Medium, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 1.0–3.0 pp
  Confidence: Medium
  · Identify lines with sustained quality loss
  · Prioritise dominant defect categories
  · Execute corrective actions and process controls
  ⚠ Trigger only if availability and performance are stable
  ⚠ Do not trigger if defects are supplier-driven

• O-O1.4 — Throughput Constraint Resolution
  Owner: operations_director
  Trigger: ops.throughput.units < 0.1%
  Impact: High, CostAvoidance
  Expected: 3.0–10.0 %
  Confidence: Medium
  · IDENTIFY each production line missing throughput plan
  · DIAGNOSE the dominant constraint (availability, performance, quality, mix, staffing) for this line
  · ACTIVATE or REPRIORITISE relevant execution Action Codes for this line
  ⚠ Trigger only if OEE components are within acceptable range
  ⚠ Do not trigger if throughput miss is demand-driven'
